# winappsdk-WinUI

**IMPORTANT**: Packages in the `winappsdk-*` namespace cannot be used without the
Windows App Runtime. This has to be installed manually by the end user. Read the
[PyWinRT winappsdk documentation](https://pywinrt.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/winappsdk/index.html)
for more information.

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for the `winappsdk-WinUI` namespace.

This package provides the `winappsdk.WinUI.<namespaces>` module.
